collection.title: Daihatsu Sirion 1998 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Daihatsu Sirion 1998 to 2004 requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Sirion which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
